title: ERY Culture, Festival and Exhibit Facility
previewText: For purposes of this Chapter, all references to community facility, community facility use or uses listed under Use Group III, in connection with Eastern Rail Yard Subarea A1 shall be deemed to include an ERY Culture, Festival and Exhibit Facility.
